scope: Real anonymous browser startup and scoped map regressions only. Not every Goodies button, signed-in role, provider sandbox or installed device.

before.cause: react-native-maps native codegen imported into the web bundle before the app could mount.

after.scope: Actual anonymous web entry only; not signed-in or installed-device acceptance.

uiChangeScope: Required browser unavailable state and map accessibility labels; native layouts/styles preserved.

afterProductionModeExport.scope: Actual anonymous web entry only; not signed-in or installed-device acceptance.

offlineConfiguration: The CI verification export uses an intentionally unusable public key. Chrome blocks all external page requests; backend connectivity is not asserted by this check.
